mapper.sql: purchase_receive_results.id AS id, purchase_receive_results.date AS `date`, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM purchase_receive_results prr INNER JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.purchase_request_id = prr.purchase_request_id INNER JOIN user_location_groups ulg ON prr.location_group_id = ulg.location_group_id WHERE prr.status = 2 AND prr.type = 2 AND ulg.user_id = #{userId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isNotAllowDisapproved, purchase_receive_results.code AS code, purchase_receive_results.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, purchase_receive_results.location_group_id AS warehouseId, locations.name AS locationName, purchase_receive_results.location_id AS locationId, purchase_receive_results.purchase_request_id AS purchaseOrderId, purchase_requests.pr_code AS purchaseOrderCode, purchase_requests.order_date AS purchaseOrderDate, purchase_receive_results.purchase_order_id AS purchaseBillId, purchase_orders.po_code AS purchaseBillCode, CONCAT(vendors.vendor_code, ' - ', vendors.name) AS vendorName, purchase_receive_results.vendor_id AS vendorId, purchase_receive_results.note AS note, purchase_receive_results.approved AS approved, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS approvedBy, purchase_receive_results.disapproved AS disapproved, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS disapprovedBy, purchase_receive_results.status AS status

FROM purchase_receive_results LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = purchase_receive_results.company_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_receive_results.vendor_id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = purchase_receive_results.location_group_id LEFT JOIN locations ON locations.id = purchase_receive_results.location_id LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_orders.id = purchase_receive_results.purchase_order_id LEFT JOIN purchase_requests ON purchase_requests.id = purchase_receive_results.purchase_request_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = purchase_receive_results.approved_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = purchase_receive_results.disapproved_by
mapper.select: SELECT purchase_receives.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, purchase_receives.product_id AS productId, pro.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_receives.date_expired AS expDate, purchase_receives.qty AS qty, purchase_receives.qty_uom_id AS uomId, IFNULL(purchase_receives.conversion, 1) AS conversion, IFNULL(purchase_receives.lots_number,'0') AS lotNo FROM purchase_receives LEFT JOIN products AS pro ON pro.id = purchase_receives.product_id WHERE purchase_receives.status > 0 AND purchase_receives.purchase_receive_result_id = #{id}

SELECT purchase_request_details.purchase_request_id AS purchaseOrderId, purchase_receives.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, purchase_request_details.product_id AS productId, pro.code AS upc, pro.description AS description, pro.barcode AS sku, pro.name AS productName, pro.unit_cost AS unitCost, pro.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, purchase_receives.date_expired AS expDate, purchase_request_details.qty AS qty, purchase_receives.qty AS qtyReceive, purchase_request_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uom.name AS uom, IFNULL(pro.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(purchase_receives.conversion, 1) AS conversion, IFNULL(purchase_receives.lots_number,'0') AS lotNo FROM purchase_receives LEFT JOIN purchase_receive_results ON purchase_receive_results.id = purchase_receives.purchase_receive_result_id LEFT JOIN purchase_requests ON purchase_requests.id = purchase_receive_results.purchase_request_id LEFT JOIN purchase_request_details ON purchase_request_details.purchase_request_id = purchase_requests.id LEFT JOIN products AS pro ON pro.id = purchase_request_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms AS uom ON uom.id = purchase_request_details.qty_uom_id WHERE purchase_receives.status >= 0 AND purchase_receives.purchase_receive_result_id = #{id} AND purchase_receive_results.type = 2 GROUP BY purchase_request_details.product_id, pro.code, pro.description, pro.barcode, pro.name, purchase_receives.date_expired, purchase_request_details.qty_uom_id, uom.name, purchase_receives.lots_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_receive_results ( type, company_id, location_group_id, location_id, code, purchase_request_id, vendor_id, `date`, note, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( 2, #{goodReceiptNote.companyId}, #{goodReceiptNote.locationGroupId}, #{goodReceiptNote.locationId}, #{goodReceiptNote.code}, #{goodReceiptNote.purchaseRequestId}, #{goodReceiptNote.vendorId}, #{goodReceiptNote.date}, #{goodReceiptNote.note}, NOW(), #{goodReceiptNote.createdBy}, #{goodReceiptNote.status} )

INSERT INTO purchase_receives ( purchase_receive_result_id, product_id, qty, qty_uom_id, date_expired, conversion, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{goodReceiptNoteDetail.purchaseReceiveResultId}, #{goodReceiptNoteDetail.productId}, #{goodReceiptNoteDetail.qty}, #{goodReceiptNoteDetail.qtyUomId}, #{goodReceiptNoteDetail.expireDate}, #{goodReceiptNoteDetail.conversion}, NOW(), #{goodReceiptNoteDetail.createdBy} )

INSERT INTO purchase_receive_results ( company_id, type, `code`, location_group_id, location_id, purchase_request_id, `date`, vendor_id, note, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{goodReceiptNote.companyId}, 2, #{goodReceiptNote.code}, #{goodReceiptNote.locationGroupId}, #{goodReceiptNote.locationId}, #{goodReceiptNote.purchaseRequestId}, #{goodReceiptNote.date}, #{goodReceiptNote.vendorId}, #{goodReceiptNote.note}, NOW(), #{goodReceiptNote.modifiedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE status > 0 AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(NOW()) AND code LIKE '%GRR%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(qty * IFNULL(conversion, 1)) AS qty FROM purchase_receives WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND purchase_receive_result_id IN (SELECT id FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE purchase_request_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND status > 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_requests SET goods_receive_note_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{purchaseOrderId}
